title: Luxury Upholstered Beds Delivered to Manchester
body:
Luxury Upholstered Beds Delivered to Manchester

Eagle Bed delivers beautiful handmade upholstered beds across Greater Manchester — including Manchester City Centre, Salford, Stockport, Oldham, Rochdale, Bolton, Wigan and Trafford. Search for a wingback bed in Manchester, an ottoman storage bed or a Chesterfield bed in Manchester and Eagle Bed has you covered with free delivery across Great Britain in 3 to 5 working days.

Handmade Beds for Manchester Homes

Each bed is crafted to order at our workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire — just a short distance from Manchester. 100% solid wood frames, premium velvet fabrics, 13 colour options and full size range from Single to Super King. Bespoke beds made for Manchester bedrooms at competitive prices.
